title: What does the Skill Development Training Schemes and Skill U

messages.content: What does the Skill Development Training Schemes and Skill Upgradation Training Schemes scheme provide?

The Skill Development Training Schemes and Skill Upgradation Training Schemes provide the following:

- **Reimbursement of up to 50% of tuition fees** for skill development and upgradation training.
- Benefits for **educated unemployed youth** and existing employees of **Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises** in Tamil Nadu.
- Support for **vulnerable sections of society** and **rural people**.
- Coverage for **backward areas of the state**.
- Inclusion of various sectors such as **cottage / handicrafts** and **agro-based enterprises**.

For more details, you can visit the source: [Skill Development Training Schemes and Skill Upgradation Training Schemes](https://www.tn.gov.in/scheme_details.php?id=MzE=).
